svg.text: Figure 6. Working of the Fuzzy LP-PPO UAV-Selection Agent
Implementation-faithful trace of state construction, internal candidate screening/ranking, actor–critic inference, constraint adaptation, warm start, and PPO learning

g.text: Delay, PDR, fuzzy priority, and λ are excluded.
training: sample rank · evaluation: arg max rank
action is a ranked position, not a permanent UAV ID
screening is internal; standard PPO still outputs all 8 action probabilities
consume 1–3 energy units on selected UAV
task + QoS + fuzzy priority − adaptive penalty
pre-drain energy in reward; post-drain energy logged
retained across resets; penalty affects later rewards
store observation, action, reward, value, log probability
updated policy used by subsequent decisions
